topic: Moving expenses (line 21900): 40 km closer test; deductible only from income earned at the new work location; unused part carried forward; reimbursed amounts excluded

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): employee moves Winnipeg → Calgary in November 2025; $6,000 eligible expenses (movers $4,000, travel $800, temporary lodging $1,200), not reimbursed; $4,000 employment income at the new location in 2025; the unused $2,000 is deducted from 2026 income at the same new location. Tax saved depends on the marginal rate (not shown).

sources.test: canada.ca line 21900 (2025): new home at least 40 km closer (shortest public route) to the new work location; establish the new home where you normally live
sources.income: canada.ca line 21900: deduct only from employment/self-employment income earned at the new work location; not investment income or EI
sources.carry: canada.ca line 21900: unused net moving expenses carried forward to future income at the new work location; no carry-back
sources.reimb: canada.ca line 21900: if the employer reimbursed you, include it in income or reduce the expenses by it
sources.expenses: canada.ca line 21900 / Folio S1-F3-C4: transportation and storage, travel, temporary living expenses (up to 15 days) among eligible expenses
